title: COORDINATION LEDGER — the living single-source-of-truth for outward work
purpose: One structured file the whole team (JEEVES / Claude / Cursor / K3 / fleet) reads + appends to, so outreach, connections, accounts (metadata only, NEVER secrets), moves, and status are mapped and tracked in the SAME place — no duplication, no orphaned work.

rules.dedup_key: every entry has a stable `key` = slug of {type}:{target}. Never create a duplicate; update the existing entry.
rules.never_store: passwords, API keys, private keys, or any secret. Accounts list fields/status only, never credentials.
rules.append_only: correct in place, but history is preserved in the `history` array — never silently delete an outreach.
rules.grammar: measurement not certification (JI.4). Wall: an attestation is an opinion/measurement, never a token, never ownership, never a claim. R8 regulators free forever.
